svg.title: Repair configuration through the owner of desired state
svg.desc: A time-bound AWS Config finding first requires a fresh read of the exact account, Region and resource. Then identify the reviewed owner of the intended value. Three alternative paths follow: change Terraform source and inspect its plan; update the launch template and stage an Auto Scaling fleet refresh; or version a Systems Manager State Manager association for a supported, reachable managed node. Every path still needs the exact target and effective permissions, bounded approval and execution, then an independent read of configuration and customer outcome. Automation can perform a bounded action but does not become the desired-state owner merely because it runs.
svg.text: Repair through the owner of the setting.
A Config finding is evidence, not authority to change it.
Check account, Region, resource, rule, and time.
Choose one of these alternative routes.
Edit reviewed source; inspect plan before apply.
State Manager owns a node setting
Version its association; check node reachability.
Every route still needs the same fence
Approval, bounded work, and conflict stop.
Fresh read of the setting and customer result.
An Automation runbook may act; it is not the owner.
Teaching map only; no repair is installed or authorized here.
